results.sql: CREATE TABLE duels (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(16)))), challenger_id TEXT NOT NULL, target_id TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, duel_tip_amount INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', winner_id TEXT, challenger_proof TEXT, target_proof TEXT, challenger_proof_value INTEGER DEFAULT 0, target_proof_value INTEGER DEFAULT 0, accepted_at TEXT, ends_at TEXT, resolved_at TEXT, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, announced_at TEXT, is_public_announced INTEGER DEFAULT 0, stream_ready INTEGER DEFAULT 0, stream_url TEXT, audience_tips_challenger REAL DEFAULT 0, audience_tips_target REAL DEFAULT 0, community_vote_challenger INTEGER DEFAULT 0, community_vote_target INTEGER DEFAULT 0, post_id TEXT REFERENCES posts(id), window_hours INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 168, dispute_status TEXT DEFAULT 'none' CHECK (dispute_status IN ('none','window_open','reported','resolved')), dispute_deadline TEXT, dispute_reported_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id), dispute_reason TEXT, payout_released INTEGER DEFAULT 0)
